name: Stone manor with stair turret
description: Norman manor house (manoir), 17 x 10 m, of dressed rubble stone with quoins, string course and architrave windows, under a steep slate roof between stone gables with tall chimneys; a round stair turret with slit windows and a conical spire stands against the front. Hall, salon and dining room with fireplaces; three bedrooms; two stairs; ivy.

steps.note: core A: level 0 up to the half landing
core B: level 1 down to the half landing
